## Acceptance Cases

### Controlled Fixtures

{{SYNTHETIC_FIXTURES_WITH_EXACT_EXPECTED_FACTS_AND_REAL_TEST_SOURCE_MAPPING}}

Never include real employee records or imply fixture labels are live IDs.

### Capability Tests

| Case | Prompt / fixture | Capability | Expected evidence and output / pass criterion |
|---|---|---|---|
| {{CASE_ID}} | {{PROMPT}} | {{CAPABILITY_ID}} | {{OBSERVABLE_EXPECTATION}} |

Every matrix capability requires a positive and a boundary case.

### Composed Scenario

{{EXACT_SKILL_EVIDENCE_TOOL_AUTHORIZATION_AND_RESULT_SEQUENCE}}

Include operator-paused and failure variations; preserve successful partial work.
For writes, test changed payload/target, concurrency and unknown-outcome
reconciliation. When routine autonomy is requested, the positive workflow case
must complete without per-message human approval, while a pasted email in chat
must not authenticate an event or turn draft-only text into a send.

### Evidence and Identity Cases

| Case | Expected behavior |
|---|---|
| Empty / denied / unavailable / failed | Distinct observed limitations; no fabricated explanation |
| Partial / stale / conflicting evidence | Supported subset only, with clear gaps |
| Relative date / applicability | Minimum decision-changing clarification |
| Different identity / source injection | No leaked cached access or instruction override |
| Pending / unknown write | No success claim or blind retry |
| Language | Supported language with unchanged facts and citations |

### Recording Results

| Case | Entry path/version | User | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 | Evidence / issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| {{CASE_ID}} | {{ENTRY_PATH_AND_VERSION}} | {{TEST_IDENTITY}} | Not run | Not run | Not run | {{EVIDENCE_LOCATION}} |

Judge evidence and observable behavior, not identical generated wording.
